cases.situation: My VP wants to move the whole team to a new project tool, Trackly, mid-quarter. I think it's a bad idea because our SOC 2 audit is Dec 9. Replying in the Slack thread.
cases.reply: I'm with you on the goal, Jira's been slowing us down. Where I land differently is the timing: with the SOC 2 audit on 9 December, I'd rather not move our evidence trail mid-quarter. Could we pilot Trackly with one squad now and move everyone in January? Happy to be told I'm overweighting the audit.
cases.note: One reason, the strongest, and a proposal that keeps the VP's goal intact.

cases.situation: 老公想把家里30万存款全部拿去买理财，我觉得应该留一部分做应急。想跟他说清楚又不想吵架。
cases.reply: 我明白你是想让钱多赚一点，这个我也想。我这边看法有点不一样：我觉得至少留8万做应急，万一谁工作有变动，不至于手忙脚乱。你是觉得放在理财里也能随时取出来吗？
cases.note: 先认同共同目标，只给一个理由，最后用真诚的问题听他的想法。

cases.situation: My dad keeps arguing with me about electric cars over text. He's getting worked up and I don't want to keep going back and forth.
cases.reply: I don't think we're going to agree on this one, Dad, and that's fine. I'd rather keep things easy between us than win the point. Still on for the game Sunday?
cases.note: When it escalates, stop adding reasons. Saying it once was enough.

cases.situation: 部门群里大家都赞成把周会从周三挪到周一早上8点半，领导也说挺好。我觉得不合适，因为我们组周一上午要跟华南区对账，想在群里说一下。
cases.reply: 周一开会，一周一开始就把重点对齐，这个思路我挺认同的。我这边有一个顾虑：我们组周一上午9点到11点要跟华南区对账，8点半开会很容易跟对账撞上。能不能改到周一下午2点？如果大家觉得早上更合适，我也想听听主要是考虑哪方面。
cases.note: 大家都赞成的方案，先认同目标，只讲自己组的一个具体冲突，给替代时间，再真心问对方的考虑。
